answer: Temporal Reputation Decay Curve. Each new identity starts inside a probation kernel where its outgoing actions carry a settlement delay proportional to cohort density; as active identities in a nebula-wide window rise, the delay and per-action escrow grow convexly. An attacker sustaining N puppets pays N times the escrowed float locked per action, plus forfeited onyx penalties on any flag. Cost scales superlinearly, not as a one-time gate.
